title: The interactive seat's mock-route turns journal zero records — the creation chain's last blocker
checklist: Reproduce on the emulator: official interactive seat (release), no staged credential, prompt any session (page-created OR the boot s-b4-ondevice-0001) — session/page returns records:0 while the model round DID run (httpFetch dispatched, scripted SSE served, turn/end fires ~50ms later, no error logged)

Narrow the route: T-0047 proved REAL-backend streaming turns journal fine on this seat — drive one turn with the staged bigmodel credential and one with the mock route; if real journals and mock does not, the defect is the mock-route adapter path on the interactive seat

Suspect surface (from the 2026-10-09 session): the agent loop's post-response append path — the turn completes without appending user/assistant records to the store the session/page projection reads; compare with the drive seat where the same mock SSE journals fine (the session.mock-llm scenario and the composer write legs are green)

[x] Fix + device-verify: records appear for both routes, the pomodoro scripted turn's write tool calls execute (fsWrite lands plugins/pomodoro-clock/), and the approval dialog → live mount → native surface chain completes end to end

void.reason: Premise dissolved (rule 9): the 'zero-journal' was a throughSeq misread — session/page with throughSeq:-1 returns empty by design, throughSeq:0 returned all 10 records (diagnosed on the 2026-10-09 diagnostic build: write.turn.settled carried the full mock text). The REAL blockers of the creation chain were (a) the scripted CJK marker — this build host mangles compiled CJK literal bytes and the committed \u escape misspelled 茄 — fixed by the codepoint scan, and (b) OfficialServe's event sinks wired to onBusLine (JS→host parser) so timer.fire/surface.input never reached the runtime on the interactive seat — fixed via hostEvent (deliverRuntimeEvent). Both landed in PR #425 with full device evidence (item 4, ticked): prompt → approval → live mount → native surface → tap 开始 ticks 1 Hz → tap 重置 restores 25:00.
